title: Build a bucketed traffic rollup
statement_md:
# Bucketed traffic rollup

A monitoring service stores one nonnegative request count per second and needs a rollup
feature for its dashboard. Implement it across two files: `app/rollup.py` and
`app/service.py`. `app/models.py` is trusted, working support code and must remain unchanged.

`validate_values(values)` (in `app/models.py`) returns a copy of the values and raises ValueError
unless every value is a nonnegative integer (bool is rejected).

`rollup(values, size)` validates the values, then returns the sum of each consecutive bucket of
`size` values, in order. The last bucket may be shorter. Empty input returns []. A size below 1
raises ValueError.

`peak_bucket(values, size)` returns {"index": i, "total": t} for the bucket with the largest
total, choosing the earliest bucket on ties. With no values it returns None. Invalid values or
sizes raise ValueError. Do not mutate inputs. Only standard-library code is allowed.

Example 1:
Input: rollup([4, 1, 0, 3, 2], 2)
Output: [5, 3, 2]

Example 2:
Input: peak_bucket([2, 3, 5, 0, 1, 4], 2)
Output: {"index": 0, "total": 5}
